move: stacked job cards rise as one, fan down into a list, restack
how: Two blurred colour blobs drift on a yoyo the whole duration. Three masked heading lines rise (yPercent 110→0, expo.out, stagger 0.1). Three job cards start stacked 14px apart at y +600 / rotateX 30 / opacity 0 with scale 1-0.05*i; they rise as one with expo.out over 1s (0.08s offsets), then at 19% fan down into a list (y i*172, scale 1) with back.out(1.5) over 0.9s at 0.1s offsets. A CTA button pops back.out(2.5), an 'open positions' counter tweens 0→12 (power2.out, 1s), and four avatar circles pop with back.out(3) stagger 0.08. From 40% each row in turn lifts x 16 with a deeper box-shadow and its arrow nudges x 8 (power3.out then power3.inOut), and the button pulses scale 1.05 yoyo ×3. Exit at 84%: cards restack with expo.inOut, then drop +700 with rotateX 30 and fade, headings leave upward, pops scale to 0.
adapt: Replace the three role titles/locations, the icon tile colours, the heading lines, the open-position count and the blob colours; keep the rise-then-fan timing (1.0s expo.out, fan at 1.7s with back.out(1.5)) and the 172px row pitch.
port: mount(el, shot) builds blobs, header, deck, CTA and faces and applies the stacked gsap.set starts; animate(el, shot, D) returns the timeline with rise at 0.06D, fan at 0.19D, hover loop 0.4-0.73D, restack at 0.84D. Scope '.c1..c3', '.cnt .n', '.faces i' to el; boxShadow tweens are string tweens and port directly.
caveats: blobs use filter: blur(60px) on 500-600px elements, moderately slow to render
boxShadow is tweened as a string on each hover lift
